<h3 class="awr">Time Model Statistics</h3>
<ul>
<li class="awr">DB Time represents total time in user calls</li>
<li class="awr">DB CPU represents CPU time of foreground processes</li>
<li class="awr">Total CPU Time represents foreground and background processes</li>
<li class="awr">Statistics including the word "background" measure background process
   time, therefore do not contribute to the DB time statistic</li>
<li class="awr">Ordered by % of DB time in descending order, followed by Statistic Name</li>
</ul>

<tr><td scope="row" class='awrnc'><a class="awr" name="3hdkutq4krg4c"></a>3hdkutq4krg4c</td><td class='awrnc'><pre_sqltext class="awr">
with last_run as
(
SELECT all_runs.OWNER,
all_runs.JOB_NAME,
all_runs.STATUS
FROM DBA_SCHEDULER_JOB_RUN_DETAILS all_runs,
(SELECT sub.OWNER,
sub.JOB_NAME,
MAX(sub.ACTUAL_START_DATE) AS START_DATE
FROM DBA_SCHEDULER_JOB_RUN_DETAILS sub
WHERE sub.job_name in (SELECT job_name FROM DBA_SCHEDULER_JOB_RUN_DETAILS where status = 'FAILED')
GROUP BY sub.OWNER, JOB_NAME) latest_runs
WHERE all_runs.status = 'FAILED'
AND all_runs.OWNER= latest_runs.OWNER
AND all_runs.JOB_NAME= latest_runs.JOB_NAME
AND all_runs.ACTUAL_START_DATE=latest_runs.START_DATE
)

SELECT NVL(SUM(broken), 0),
NVL(SUM(failed), 0)
FROM (SELECT DECODE(broken,  'N',  0,  1) broken,
DECODE(NVL(failures, 0),  0,  0,  1) failed
FROM dba_jobs
UNION ALL
SELECT DECODE(STATE, 'BROKEN', 1, 0) broken,
DECODE(STATUS , 'FAILED', DECODE(STATE, 'BROKEN', 0, 'DISABLED', 0, 1), 0) failed
FROM (SELECT all_jobs.OWNER,
all_jobs.JOB_NAME,
last_run.STATUS,
all_jobs.STATE
FROM last_run,
DBA_SCHEDULER_JOBS all_jobs
WHERE last_run.OWNER=all_jobs.OWNER
AND last_run.JOB_NAME=all_jobs.JOB_NAME))


</pre_sqltext></td></tr>

<tr><td scope="row" class='awrnc'><a class="awr" name="c57z1zv4pf111"></a>c57z1zv4pf111</td><td class='awrnc'><pre_sqltext class="awr">DECLARE
	V_IP VARCHAR2(20);
	v_instance_number number;
	v_machinename v$session.machine%type;
	v_osuser      v$session.osuser%type;
	v_dbuser      v$session.username%type;
	v_type        v$session.type%type;
	v_service_name v$session.service_name%type;
	v_program    varchar2(50);
	v_module    varchar2(50);
	v_sesion_sid number;
	v_sesion_serial number;
	v_idlog number;
	v_check number := 1; --0: pasa. 1:no pasa
	v_out_check number;
	v_out_ses varchar2(1000);
	v_out_apl varchar2(1000);
	v_nivel_log number;
	v_server_host varchar2(1000);
	v_profile varchar2(30);
	v_rcgroup varchar2(32);
	v_admindba varchar2(1) := 'N';

BEGIN
	-- Obtencion de constantes
    V_IP := SYS_CONTEXT('USERENV',  'IP_ADDRESS');
	v_instance_number := SYS_CONTEXT('USERENV',  'INSTANCE');
	v_server_host := upper(SYS_CONTEXT('USERENV',  'SERVER_HOST'));

	SELECT valor into v_nivel_log from astsysadmin.t_parametros where keyid=10003;

	BEGIN
		DBMS_SESSION.SET_IDENTIFIER('#IP'||V_IP||'#'||USER);
    EXCEPTION
		WHEN OTHERS THEN
			DBMS_SESSION.SET_IDENTIFIER(USER);
    END;

	-- Se obtiene toda la informacion de la sesion
	SELECT sid,  serial#,  UPPER(machine),  UPPER(username),  upper(type),  upper(service_name),  UPPER(program),  UPPER(module),  upper(osuser),  upper(resource_consumer_group)
	INTO v_sesion_sid,  v_sesion_serial,  v_machinename,  v_dbuser,  v_type,  v_service_name,  v_program,  v_module,  v_osuser,  v_rcgroup
	FROM v$session
	WHERE audsid = userenv('sessionid')
	AND rownum &lt; 2;


	-- NO SE MUEVE LA SESION,  LO METERA EN OTHERS
	if (v_service_name = 'SYS$USERS')and((v_server_host = v_machinename)or(v_server_host||'.ARAGON.LOCAL' = v_machinename)or(v_server_host = v_machinename||'.ARAGON.LOCAL')) then
		if v_nivel_log = 2 then
			insert into astsysadmin.t_mods_logon_log (idlog, logon_date, servicio, os_usuario, ora_usuario, maquina, ip, programa, modulo, origen, check_in, check_in_sess, check_in_aplic)
			values(astsysadmin.S_GES_MODS_POSTCHECK.nextval, sysdate, v_service_name, v_osuser, v_dbuser, v_machinename, v_ip, v_program, v_module, 'EXITO_TRIGGER', '0', 'SYS$USERS', 'SYS$USERS');
			commit;
		end if;

		return;
	end if;

	if v_type = 'USER' then
		-- Usuarios autorizados con el ADMINDBA = S en la t_mods_sesion
		begin
			select 0,  'S' into v_check,  v_admindba from astsysadmin.t_mods_sesion where (ora_usuario = v_dbuser or maquina = v_machinename) and admindba = 'S';

		exception
			when others then
				v_check := '1';
				v_admindba := 'N';
		end;

		if v_check = 1 then
			insert into astsysadmin.t_mods_temp_sesion(idlog, servicio, os_usuario, ora_usuario, maquina, ip, programa, modulo)
			values(1,  v_service_name,  v_osuser,  v_dbuser,  v_machinename,  V_IP,  v_program,  v_module);

			-- Se comprueba si la sesion,  el usuario,  servicio,  etc son correctos
			v_check := astsysadmin.FUNC_MODS_CHECK_SERVICES(1,  v_out_check,  v_out_ses,  v_out_apl);
		end if;

		-- Si todo es correcto se registra la entrada y se deja entrar
		if v_check = 0 then
			if v_nivel_log = 2 then
				insert into astsysadmin.t_mods_logon_log (idlog, logon_date, servicio, os_usuario, ora_usuario, maquina, ip, programa, modulo, origen, check_in, check_in_sess, check_in_aplic)
				values(astsysadmin.S_GES_MODS_POSTCHECK.nextval, sysdate, v_service_name, v_osuser, v_dbuser, v_machinename, v_ip, v_program, v_module, 'EXITO_TRIGGER', v_out_check, v_out_ses, v_out_apl);
			end if;

			if v_admindba = 'N' then
				insert into astsysadmin.t_mods_postcheck_log
				(idlog, logon_date, instance_number, sesion_sid, sesion_serial, servicio, os_usuario, ora_usuario, maquina, ip, programa, modulo)
				values(astsysadmin.S_GES_MODS_POSTCHECK.nextval, sysdate, v_instance_number, v_sesion_sid, v_sesion_serial, v_service_name, v_osuser, v_dbuser, v_machinename, v_ip, v_program, v_module);
			end if;

			commit;

			-- Se obtiene el perfil del usuario
			begin
				select p.name into v_profile from user$ u,  profname$ p where u.resource$ = p.profile# and u.name = v_dbuser;
			exception
				when others then
					v_profile := 'INDETERMINADO';
			end;

			if v_profile in ('AMS', 'CREADORES', 'CREADORES_BD', 'CUARENTENA', 'GESTION_USR_ADMIN', 'NOMINALES', 'OPERACIONES', 'POOL_BAD', 'POOL_2C', 'POOL_3C') then

				if v_rcgroup = 'OTHER_GROUPS' then
					BEGIN
					DBMS_RESOURCE_MANAGER.SWITCH_CONSUMER_GROUP_FOR_SESS (
					   session_id =&gt; v_sesion_sid,
					   session_serial =&gt; v_sesion_serial,
					   consumer_group =&gt; 'DGA_OLTP');
					END;
				end if;

			end if;
		end if;

		-- Si no le esta permitida la entrada se registra el intento y se lanza excepcion
		if v_check = 1 then
			if v_nivel_log &gt; 0 then
				insert into astsysadmin.t_mods_logon_log (idlog, logon_date, servicio, os_usuario, ora_usuario, maquina, ip, programa, modulo, origen)
				values(astsysadmin.S_GES_MODS_POSTCHECK.nextval, sysdate, v_service_name, v_osuser, v_dbuser, v_machinename, v_ip, v_program, v_module, 'TRIGGER')
				returning idlog into v_idlog;
				commit;
			end if;

			raise_application_error(-20001, 'Apertura de sesion no autorizada en el servicio solicitado. Contacte con el equipo de administracion. Suministre IDLOG: '||v_idlog);
		end if;
	end if;
END;</pre_sqltext></td></tr>

<h3 class="awr">Top Sessions</h3>

<ul>
<li class="awr"> Ping latency of the roundtrip of a message from this instance to </li>
<li class="awr"> target instances.  </li>
<li class="awr"> The target instance is identified by an instance number. </li>
<li class="awr"> Average and standard deviation of ping latency is given in microseconds </li>
<li class="awr"> for message sizes of 500 bytes and 8K. </li>
<li class="awr"> Note that latency of a message from the instance to itself is used as </li>
<li class="awr"> control, since message latency can include wait for CPU</li>
</ul>
